label.zh: 局势阶段（由进度决定，可来回）
label.en: Situation stages (set by progress, can swing back and forth)

note.en: Starts Balanced at 1500 and moves both ways: below 600 Oppressed, below 1200 Controlled, below 2400 Unrestricted, below 3000 Free.

note.zh: 进度降至0（失败）→ 强行控制 50；进度满 → 解放 70（360–2160天后另有泽珞遗产 300）。
note.en: Progress falling to 0 (fail) -> Control Enforced 50; progress full -> liberation 70 (plus Zroni Legacy 300 after 360-2160 days).

label.zh: 泽珞遗产开篇的三个版本
label.en: Three versions of the Zroni Legacy opener

note.zh: 由标志位决定：已有 zroni_intro 且非最后一个泽珞星系→301；最后一个泽珞星系→302；其余→303。
note.en: Chosen by flags: zroni_intro and not the last Zroni system -> 301; last Zroni system -> 302; neither -> 303.

note.zh: 隐藏事件40随机抽取一项尚未拥有的灵能科技（41–47各1/7）；全都已拥有时为48（研究加成）。每次约1440–2160天后物现引擎可再次使用(39)。
note.en: Hidden 40 rolls one psionic tech you do not yet have (41-47, equal weights); if none is left, 48 (research bonus). The engine is ready again after about 1440-2160 days (39).

label.zh: 控制结局：解锁物现引擎

note.zh: 重同化完成，30天后解锁科技。
note.en: Reintegration done; the tech unlocks 30 days later.

note.zh: 指引项目完成，获得永久修正。
note.en: The Guide project completes; a permanent modifier is added.

label.en: Traitor path: the entity is trapped

note.zh: 虚境实体被困；失去平衡仪便会使其挣脱。
note.en: The Shroud entity is trapped; losing an equilibrator frees it.

notes.zh: 局势开始后2–7天触发；三个选项分别设定局势方针（安抚/镇压/扶持）并各引向一个“……”后续窗口（15/20/25）。
notes.en: Fires 2-7 days after the situation starts (03_origin_situations.txt:187-199); the three options set the approach (appease/suppress/support) and each leads to a short follow-up window (15/20/25).

notes.zh: 外交菜单：每个援助选项消耗泽珞、有冷却，结果为随机列表（各含10%无事发生，未列为文档）。军事:430/432/434/436；民政:438/440/442/444；研究:446/448/450与444（共享的“袭击”结果）。
notes.en: Diplomacy menu: each assistance option costs Zro and starts a cooldown, outcomes are random lists (each with a 10% nothing-happens entry that has no window): military 430/432/434/436, civic 438/440/442/444, research 446/448/450 plus the shared attack 444 (events/shroud_forged_events.txt:1862-2031).

notes.zh: 由合成女王危机（crisis.8060 的一个选项）在突破虚境的抟土之塑师起源帝国中触发；选项通向 crisis.24100。
notes.en: Fired from the Synthetic Queen crisis (crisis.8060 option) for a Shroud-Forged empire that breached the Shroud; its option leads to crisis.24100 (machine_age_crisis_events.txt:6718).
